text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having recovered from the fatigue of the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks), Ikuno Dictus entered 
the summer training camp in great shape. 
She is fired up for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the Trainer, the drive and 
determination in her eyes looked entirely 
different than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The change began after watching the Nippon 
Derby. Incidentally, Ines Fujin, who won 
that very race, had announced an extended 
period of medical leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing that something felt slightly off 
with Ikuno Dictus... the Summer Training 
Camp began.
